description: a green iron water pump on the pavement. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: A big-city quarter like Berlin: tall old town houses with stucco and balconies beside plain slab blocks of the sixties, pale plaster in cream, grey and washed-out pastel, posters and a little graffiti, tram wires, kiosks; busy, a bit rough, friendly.
